data.long_meaning: Agbogla is derived from the Greek word 'agbos' meaning 'graceful' and 'gla' meaning 'mountain'. It symbolizes a graceful, strong, and spiritual woman who is connected to the earth. The name Agbogla carries the meaning “Graceful mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Agbogla usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
